Dots rules

?
5×57×79×9
1
Draw lines
Take turns joining two dots next to each other.

Close a box

Go again

162 · Dots · полные правила
9:41

Full rules

Dots
?

Dots

2 players · 5–15 min
1

Goal

Close more boxes than your neighbour.
2

The board

A grid of dots: 5×5, 7×7 or 9×9. Nothing is drawn at the start.
3

Your move

Draw one line between two dots next to each other — across or down, never diagonal.
4

Close a box

If your line is the fourth side of a box, the box is yours and you draw again. One line can close two boxes at once.
5

End

When every line is drawn, the one with more boxes wins. Equal boxes — a draw.
6

Tip

Avoid drawing the third side of a box — it hands the box to the other player.

Checkers rules

?
RussianEnglishPool
1
Move

Full rules with pictures
170 · Checkers · полные правила
9:41

Full rules

Checkers
?

Checkers

2 players · 10–30 min
1

Goal

Take all the other player’s checkers or leave them without a move.
2

Set up

12 checkers each on the dark squares of the first three rows. Light colour moves first.
3

Move

One square diagonally forward onto an empty dark square.
4

Take

Jump over a neighbouring checker onto the empty square behind it. Taking is required; keep jumping while you can. In Russian rules checkers may take backwards too.
5

King

A checker that reaches the far row becomes a king. In Russian rules the king flies any distance diagonally; in English rules it moves one square in any diagonal direction.
6

End

No checkers or no moves — you lose. Agreed or repeated three times — a draw.

Full rules

Chess
?

Chess

2 players · 10–60 min
1

Goal

Checkmate: the king is attacked and has no safe square.
2

Pieces

King one square any way. Queen any distance any way. Rook straight. Bishop diagonal. Knight an L, jumping over pieces. Pawn one forward (two from the start), takes diagonally.
3

Special moves

Castling: king two squares toward a rook, the rook jumps over. En passant: a pawn takes a pawn that just moved two squares past it. Promotion: a pawn on the last row becomes any piece.
4

Check

When your king is attacked you must save it: move, block or take.
5

Draw

Stalemate (no legal move but not in check), three repetitions, 50 moves without a take or pawn move, or agreement.
6

Chess 960

The back row is shuffled; the rest is the same.

186 · Durak · полные правила

Full rules

Durak
?

Durak

2–4 players · 10–20 min
1

Goal

Get rid of your cards. The last one holding cards is the durak.
2

Deck and trump

36 cards, 6 to 10 and J Q K A. Six cards each; the next card shows the trump suit and lies under the deck.
3

Attack

The attacker plays a card. Others may add cards of a rank already on the table, up to six or the defender’s hand.
4

Defend

Beat each card with a higher one of the same suit, or with any trump (a higher trump beats a trump). Can’t or won’t — take all the cards.
5

After the round

Beaten cards are out. Everyone draws back to six, attacker first. If the defender took, the next player attacks.
6

Passing

In the passing variant the defender may add a card of the same rank and pass the attack on.

203 · Tavli · полные правила

Full rules

Tavli
?

Tavli

2 players · 10–30 min a game
1

Goal

Bring all 15 checkers into your home and bear them off first.
2

The board

24 points in four quarters, a bar in the middle. You move in a horseshoe toward your home quarter.
3

Move

Roll two dice and move by each number, one checker or two. A double is played four times. You must use both numbers if you can.
4

Portes

A single checker is a blot: land on it and it goes to the bar. From the bar you must enter into the other home first. Two or more checkers block a point.
5

Plakoto

Land on a blot to pin it under your checker; it can’t move until you leave.
6

Fevga

No hitting. One checker alone blocks a point. Both start from the same corner and move the same way.
7

Bearing off

When all 15 are home, take checkers off by the dice. First to bear off all wins; before the other bears off any — two points.

Goal

Full rules

Poker
?

Poker

2–6 players · 30–60 min
1

Goal

Win chips with the best five-card hand or by making others fold. Chips only — no money, ever.
2

A hand

Two cards each, face down. Then five shared cards in three steps: three, one, one. Bets after each step.
3

Betting

Check (no bet), call (match), raise (bet more) or fold (give up the hand).
4

Hands, high to low

Full rules

Chess
?

Chess

2 players · 10–60 min
1

Goal

Checkmate: the king is attacked and has no safe square.
Ad slotrules, between sections320×100
2

Pieces

King one square any way. Queen any distance any way. Rook straight. Bishop diagonal. Knight an L, jumping over pieces. Pawn one forward (two from the start), takes diagonally.
3

Special moves

Castling: king two squares toward a rook, the rook jumps over. En passant: a pawn takes a pawn that just moved two squares past it. Promotion: a pawn on the last row becomes any piece.
4

Check

When your king is attacked you must save it: move, block or take.
5

Draw

Stalemate (no legal move but not in check), three repetitions, 50 moves without a take or pawn move, or agreement.
6

Chess 960

The back row is shuffled; the rest is the same.
